parameters.query: select app.flatmate_onboarding_state($1::uuid) as st, ai.prompt_for('P13_flatmate_onboarding') as p, (select jsonb_object_agg(key, value #>> '{}') from app.settings where key like 'flatmate_agent.%' or key in ('llm.default_model', 'llm.keep_alive')) as cfg

parameters.description: What the platform already knows about the person (lifestyle answers, budget, areas, move-in date, headline) and the list of what is still missing. No input.

Check the answers the person gave, before they confirm them on the page. Input: values, a JSON object with only the fields the person answered: lifestyle {smoking, pets, guests, quiet_hours: yes|no; schedule: early|late|irregular; cleanliness: high|medium|relaxed}, budget_min, budget_max (numbers), areas (list), move_in_from (YYYY-MM-DD), headline, seeking (room|flatmate|both). Returns the checked values and errors. Nothing is saved.

value.values: ={{ $fromAI('values', 'JSON object with only the fields the person answered', 'string') }}

parameters.query: select substring(message->>'content' from '<message>\n(.*)\n</message>') as text from agent_memory.chat_histories where session_id = $1 and message->>'type' = 'human' order by id desc limit 20
